prompt: What is the name of the fastest supercomputer in the world that runs on Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) and is hosted outside the United States?
answer: The answer is **Fugaku**, operated by RIKEN in Kobe, Japan. It runs Red Hat Enterprise Linux and was ranked the world’s fastest supercomputer in 2020. Its “fastest” status is historical; later rankings placed U.S.-based El Capitan at No. 1.
